purpose: The sole root-owned selection index for native Scroll World candidate production. A provider request, prompt, receipt, or candidate is invalid unless it names one of these exact scene_reference_id values and matches its collection, role, cast, CTA, journey position, and reference state.
selection_rules: No generic environment-only scene, random collection product, or historical five-world-pack prompt may substitute for an indexed scene.
A preserved scene with no locally verifiable source remains preserve-only. It is not a prompt target and may not be regenerated from description.

Every environment candidate is built only around approved exact product-on-model sources with a protected garment or accessory matte, hash-bound receipt, source/detail/script preflight, independent visual QA, and founder review.
A source-stage authority image, lookbook image, rejected candidate, or quarantined output is not a Scroll World scene reference or an approved scene input.
All scenes remain blocked from provider generation and runtime wiring until their record's source and review gates are explicitly cleared.

hero_dual_cast_four_sku_rule.scope: each collection's two hero-derived world moments together
hero_dual_cast_four_sku_rule.sku_allocation: Across the two hero moments, the man and woman receive different collection-specific selections drawn only from those moments' declared exact SKU casts. The hero pair must include four distinct exact SKUs at minimum. Every confirmed wearer/SKU allocation is explicit in the approved collection scene edit; no random or generic garment fills a look.
hero_dual_cast_four_sku_rule.placement: Both adult wearers naturally belong to each hero scene and share its floor plane, key light, shadows, reflections, depth, occlusion, and sightline or movement interaction.
hero_dual_cast_four_sku_rule.preorder_boundary: The third collection-preorder scene remains its own exact-CTA product moment and is not used to satisfy the four-SKU hero-pair requirement.
prohibitions: automatic one-man-and-one-woman duplication of every SKU
a token mixed-gender group with unassigned garments
off-scene gender coverage used as evidence for a hero scene
using preorder SKU(s) to pad a hero-pair allocation
hero_dual_cast_four_sku_rule.coverage_evidence: Each approved wearer/SKU pairing requires its own hash-bound source authority, detail check, matte, and native-integration review before the scene can promote.
hero_dual_cast_four_sku_rule.preserved_scene_rule: A preserved asset is not silently altered. If it lacks the founder-directed hero-pair allocation, the gap remains blocked until a compliant successor is supplied or produced.

hero_derived_cta_anchor_rule.scope: all three declared CTA scenes in the Black Rose and Signature collections
hero_derived_cta_anchor_rule.rule: Each declared scene carries one required primary hero-derived anchor: the exact font statue, exact scene backdrop, or exact protected graphic. The anchor is a hash-bound source object in its approved hero form, never generated replacement lettering, a generic landmark, or approximate logo art.
hero_derived_cta_anchor_rule.preserved_scene_boundary: A preserved scene retains its linked anchor as visual continuity evidence only. It remains preserve-only until the separately recorded founder candidate hash and visual review are locally verifiable.
hero_derived_cta_anchor_rule.promotion_boundary: An anchor receipt does not clear product-on-model, matte, native-integration, independent-QA, founder-approval, runtime-wiring, or deployment gates.

love_hurts_enchanted_rose_story_rule.scope: all three declared Love Hurts CTA scenes
love_hurts_enchanted_rose_story_rule.rule: Every Love Hurts scene is a high-fashion product world built around the same exact protected enchanted rose under glass. The rose remains visible, sharply legible, physically lit, and materially protected; no generic heart, flower, substitute rose silhouette, or decorative rose scatter may stand in for it.
love_hurts_enchanted_rose_story_rule.beast_perspective: Use a protective, intimate watcher viewpoint from the Beast's side of the chamber: a low or shadow-edge editorial camera held on the rose as the guarded focal object. This is perspective and emotional grammar only—never a literal Beast character, costume, face, or imitation.
love_hurts_enchanted_rose_story_rule.high_fashion_rule: Models and exact products are photographed as couture editorial subjects with deliberate negative space, sculptural stone, controlled candle/amber/crimson light, fabric texture, hardware detail, real body contact, and a single coherent lens/light field. Product clarity and the enchanted rose both remain premium focal authorities.
prohibitions: product cutouts against an unrelated cathedral plate
rose obscured by product or CTA treatment
love_hurts_enchanted_rose_story_rule.promotion_boundary: The source anchor and artistic direction do not clear exact-cast, source/matte, native-integration, independent visual-QA, founder promotion, wiring, or deployment gates.
